dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: A multi-copy AWS staging simulation exposed process-local identity/session state: 7 of 9 personas lost sign-in. The read-through fix is merged, but a clean fully concurrent post-fix rerun with multiple API copies is still required.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: The audit-to-website funnel, onboarding, live payment infrastructure and product UX are strong enough to sell, but there is still no repeatable real-traffic to paying-customer loop or measured CAC.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified external paying Business Builder cohort, recurring Business Builder MRR, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Internal tests and synthetic personas do not count.

changed: The biggest positive change is the $395 existing-business audit becoming a genuinely sellable end-to-end Business Builder wedge: the canonical product now has the audit engine, evidence-backed downloadable report, public sample, human review console, business-aware website analysis, a 60-day $395 credit, and a fixed-price $795 website upsell that applies that credit. The main regression is reliability: a newer AWS cloud simulation scaled staging to three API copies and 7 of 9 personas lost sign-in because identity/session state was still process-local. The session read-through defect is fixed on main, but a clean multi-copy rerun is still required before reliability earns 90+.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-28 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder execution state, live/staging simulation evidence, the audit-to-website commercial flow, current founder-action/verification and AI-workforce behavior, and only directly relevant Stromation website-generation evidence. Archived buisnessbuilder-future history and unrelated Stromation ventures/company metrics are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
